name: AZD1163
sort_evidence: AZD1163 is a first-in-class anti-PAD2/4 bispecific antibody with no INN and no row in the book (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41982149/), in the Phase 2 LaunchPAD-RA trial NCT07276581 (Recruiting).

trials.title: A Study to Investigate Efficacy and Safety of AZD1163 in Participants With Rheumatoid Arthritis
